observations.evidence_surface: Platypus canonical Workspace Context configuration and owner/admin update path
observations.result_summary: At the canonical assessed Platypus revision, Workspace Context is a validated Workspace update field on the owner/org-admin update surface; first-party frontend tests load a concrete `Be brief` Context value and exercise the Workspace save payload, while backend route tests exercise the authorized Workspace update path.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. The backend route test changes the Workspace name rather than a non-empty Context value, and the frontend save regression sends an empty Context as null; this observation therefore does not claim one test persists a concrete changed Context value and later consumes that same value.

observations.evidence_surface: Platypus canonical Workspace Context system-prompt regression
observations.result_summary: At the canonical assessed Platypus revision, a first-party system-prompt regression sets a concrete Workspace Context value (`We sell rare books.`) and verifies that the renderer places that exact value inside the native `<workspace>` system-prompt fragment.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. The prompt-rendering regression receives Context through its test fixture; it does not itself perform the Workspace owner/admin update that persisted the value.

observations.evidence_surface: Platypus canonical persisted Workspace row to Chat-turn system-prompt path
observations.result_summary: At the canonical assessed Platypus revision, the shipped `prepareChatTurn()` path reads the current Workspace row, passes `workspace.context` into `renderSystemPrompt(...)`, and returns the composed prompt as the Chat turn's `stream.system`; a first-party Drizzle-backed integration suite exercises this turn-preparation path.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. The Drizzle-backed integration fixture has Workspace Context set to null, so this wiring evidence must not be combined with the separate concrete prompt fixture into a claim that one empirical run persisted and then consumed the same changed Context value.
